```python
import random

def generate_palindrome(length):
    half = length // 2
    result = ''.join(random.choices('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', k=half))
    return result + result[::-1] if length % 2 == 0 else result[:-1] + result[::-1]

print(generate_palindrome(305))
```

This program generates a random string of letters, then concatenates its reverse to the end. If the desired length is odd, it removes the last character from the original string before reversing.

Note that due to the randomness, this palindrome will be different every time you run the program.
